description: Auto-adopt updated toolchains. The root package.json packageManager field is the single Bun version source: CI installs exactly that version, and Renovate bumps it (plus bun.lock) whenever a new Bun ships. Newer runtimes stay compatible because the pre-push hook accepts a caret range and no runtime code gates on an exact Bun version.

packageRules.description: Auto-adopt new Bun releases: bump packageManager + bun.lock, merge when CI is green
Bun major/canary bumps get a PR but need human review
Auto-merge GitHub Actions version bumps (minor, patch, digest)
